scenario: `e.fired_at in (now() - 1_h .. now())`, a `Time` point in a constructed `Interval<Time>`, is `Bool` (LINT.3.1.1) with matching element types (LINT.3.1.3), so it compiles as a `where`. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: the half-open bounds are logical/LINT.3.1's, and no lowering is observed.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule recent:
    Event e where e.fired_at in (now() - 1_h .. now())
->
    log info "recent"
